findings.label: End-to-end capture unverified
findings.detail: The .m3u8 capture step (_fetch_listing_html browser fetch and full resolve_match path) was never run because Playwright is absent in the dev env. The Pi-side live check in verification.md step 5 is still pending and is the only thing that proves the user-visible tap path plays. Must be run on the device before declaring the user's symptom fixed.

findings.label: Hybrid path still broken (out of scope)
findings.detail: _resolve_hybrid in resolvers.py fetches the same listing with requests + make_session and hits the same Cloudflare 403. Correctly left out of scope and flagged in the commit body; track it as a separate task so the hourly pre-scrape doesn't silently keep failing.

findings.label: Weak decoy assertion in test
findings.detail: test_team_decoy_is_never_returned asserts `url is None or "/teams/" not in url`, which passes trivially because the real Raiders-vs-Patriots anchor matches the given terms first. The decoy is genuinely excluded by the -vs- regex so the test is not wrong, but the assertion does not isolate the decoy. Optional tightening.
